title: A merge trial that breaks a test with an open flaky item is refused
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: with an open "Flaky check on main" item for a test, a candidate whose merge trial fails that test while the base tip passes it is refused naming the file, and the flaky item excuses nothing.

steps.name: Refuse a candidate that breaks a test with an open flaky item through the real loop
